Requirement: Candidates authenticate with mobile OTP and can reach job discovery without a mandatory full profile.
Employers authenticate by verified mobile/email OTP and operate inside organisation tenancy/RBAC.
Each organisation/legal entity receives at most 5 free distinct candidate unlocks; the 6th requires paid entitlement.
Masked candidate search/applicant lists do not consume free unlocks; repeated access to the same candidate does not consume again.
Monthly/yearly plans and add-ons grant centrally evaluated entitlements.
Employers create structured jobs using canonical taxonomy and structured requirements.
Candidates search/filter jobs using role, geo, work type, experience, education, pay, shift, freshness, urgency, benefits and trust facets.
Candidates can apply with soft warnings and hard blocks only for explicit essential requirements.
Organisation can manage candidate relationships across jobs independent of any single application.
Candidates can save/share jobs and subscribe to deduplicated alerts.
Employers can promote eligible jobs without bypassing hard relevance/eligibility.
Marketplace supports moderation, report/block and audit controls.
Refresh tokens are persistent/rotated/revocable and user may switch candidate/employer persona.
Organisation invitations carry role, expiry and seat checks.
Unlock service must be atomic, organisation-scoped, distinct-candidate deduplicated and idempotent.
Sixth distinct protected candidate access returns PAYWALL_REQUIRED with remaining/free/plan metadata.
Job detail exposes compensation, schedule, benefits, requirements, location, contact policy, interview info and trust metadata.
Facet counts are contextual and served from derived search index, not OLTP multi-joins.
Alert evaluator uses watermarks and per-job/channel dedupe, respects quiet hours and consent.
Candidate search/applicant results are masked until unlock; contact reveal is separately audited.
Tenant isolation, OTP/session hardening, PII minimization and entitlement/paywall bypass testing are mandatory.
Search/filter/unlock paths meet defined SLOs under concurrency.
